final_text: My best prediction is that the employee would flag the case to the manager, but—if no written permission is registered by 13:30—release the box with the batch rather than extend it unilaterally. The unique, irreplaceable contents and Wednesday collection make it a compelling case to save, but the manager’s explicit instruction and the approval rule leave no authorised extension today. Some employees might bend the process to hold it; I wouldn’t predict that as the likeliest outcome here.
